C1287.title: Helibao Payment Fined 74.88 Million Yuan for Four Regulatory Violations
C1287.summary: On December 31, 2025, the Guangdong Branch of the People's Bank of China published administrative penalty information showing that Guangzhou Helibao Payment Technology Co., Ltd. was warned and publicly criticized for violations of clearing management rules, payment acceptance terminal and related business regulations, merchant management rules, and account management regulations. The company had 12.08 million yuan in illegal gains confiscated and was fined 62.80 million yuan, for a total penalty and confiscation amount of 74.88 million yuan. A responsible individual, Zhao, was fined 925,000 yuan.
